purpose: Separate nonlinear-process validation and fully crossed robustness; no additional evidence gate
plant: Two noninteracting gravity-drained tanks in cascade; pump feeds tank 1; PI on true tank-2 level
equations: A1 dh1/dt=q-k1 sqrt(h1); A2 dh2/dt=k1 sqrt(h1)-k2 sqrt(h2)
units: h in metres; A in m2; q in m3/s; k in m^(5/2)/s; report level=100*h2
integration: RK4 10 ms; PI update 20 ms; telemetry every 200 ms; 60 s virtual horizon
age_rule: capture age=transport+buffer+0.12 if delayed_evidence fault active; signed capture timestamp retained
outcomes: Same trailing-three physical/service/target/write criterion and forward-five failure check as Stage 4; forward five now spans 1 virtual second
primary_comparison: G3 versus G8+A; all 5760 predeclared traces; report missing/censored separately; no optimal-window selection
analysis: 20 seed blocks carrying all scenario-factor cells; 10000 percentile bootstrap replicates; analysis seed 20261107
independence: New process, controller, generator and predicate/outcome implementation; audited HMAC verifier reused deliberately as fixed mechanism
limitations: Research parameters are not fitted to Quanser or SWaT
Virtual transport and clocks; no new HTTP transactions
No physical sensors or independently validated safety oracle
Common random draws across factor cells; cells and methods are paired rather than independent
